> **Inherited from Zuri V1 · read-only.**
> Source: `G:/zuri/docs/remediation/patterns/zod-route.md` @ `0b6d3c3` · imported 2026-08-16
> This describes **V1 semantics**, where *tenant* means **one shop** — V2's scope
> chain (Portfolio → Tenant → Business → Workspace) is different. Corrections belong
> in a V2 document that cites this file, never in this file. Cite its ids with a
> `V1-` prefix (e.g. `V1-ADR-060`) so they cannot be confused with V2 ids.

Use the shared helper: import { parseBody } from '@/lib/validation/zodHelpers';
Top of file: import { z } from 'zod';
Define schema above handler, e.g.:
const Schema = z.object({
  qtyReceived: z.coerce.number().positive(),
  unitCost: z.coerce.number().nonnegative(),
  notes: z.string().max(500).optional(),
});
In handler replace `const body = await request.json()` with:
const parsed = await parseBody(Schema, request);
if (parsed.error) return parsed.error; // 400 NextResponse with issues
const body = parsed.data;
Keep all downstream logic unchanged.
